title: MEALS YOU CAN'T MISS

chapters.description: Cool rice noodles, green fish curry and a fistful of herbs
Freshwater fish steamed with coconut custard and kroeung
Peppery seared beef, crisp vegetables and a sharp lime dip

editorial: Cambodian cuisine felt quite distinct from its Southeast Asian neighbours. Fermented flavours can be strong, even pungent, and weren’t always to our taste. Prahok ktis and fish amok are two dishes to look out for.

If those flavours aren’t your thing, grilled meats offer another way to try local food. We found them more lightly seasoned than the satays we knew from Thailand and Malaysia, so they felt underwhelming when we were expecting an explosion of flavour. The buffet with our Apsara dance show was the best meal of our short stay.
